about_item: VINTAGE ENGLISH COTTAGE STYLE- Bring timeless character to your home with these vintage decorative lanterns. Featuring an antique black metal finish with a subtle grey brushed effect, they create a charming rustic atmosphere that complements farmhouse, cottage and traditional interiors.

PREMIUM METAL FRAME & TEMPERED GLASS - Crafted from durable metal with clear tempered glass panels, these lanterns offer a refined decorative appearance while allowing candlelight or LED lights to shine beautifully from every angle. The detailed roof design and antique finish add an elegant handcrafted feel.

SET OF 2 SIZES FOR LAYERED DECOR - Includes two matching lantern sizes for flexible styling: Large Lantern: 19.5 x 19.5 x 41 cm; Small Lantern: 14 x 14 x 27 cm. Display them together for a layered look or separately throughout your home.

PLACE OR HANG ANYWHERE - Designed with a practical top hanging ring and stable base, these lanterns can be displayed on tables, shelves and fireplaces or hung in covered outdoor spaces such as porches, patios and garden areas.

VERSATILE HOME & EVENT DECOR - Perfect for creating a warm atmosphere in living rooms, hallways, gardens and special occasions. Ideal for fireplace styling, garden parties, weddings, Christmas decoration and farmhouse home accessories. Candles are not included.

summary.text: Customers find the lanterns beautiful and exactly as advertised, with one mentioning they look expensive. However, the build quality receives mixed feedback, with some saying they're very well made while others find them not very well made. Moreover, durability is a concern as customers describe them as very flimsy, and several report issues with broken glass. Additionally, customers find the lanterns difficult to use, particularly noting that the glass is only held in place with tabs. Value for money is also mixed, with some finding them worth buying while others say they're not good for the price.

other_countries_reviews.title: Quality material
other_countries_reviews.text: These lanterns are a great price considering that they are metal and include the candles! I expect these to last for years and can always be touched up with black paint in years to come. I love that they don’t include glass as I have toddlers who love to look and poke at the lanterns so I don’t have to worry about breakage. I also love that I don’t have to clean the glass. I have other lanterns that have glass and the bugs get in and make a real mess of it; also the wasps like the ones with the glass better. They look beautiful on the wright iron tables of our outdoor cabin and are so cosy at night with the candles on! They are super easy to use and I also love how they can nest if and when you want to put them away for winter. Recommend!
